free_tier.stated: Signing up for the Free Trial creates a Free Trial billing account that is preloaded with $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the offer is a spending balance, not a stored object

retention.stated: the balance is deleted at day 90 or when it is spent, whichever comes first; the trial cannot be paused or extended

egress.terms: egress bills against the credit at list price; the separate always-free allowance is 1 GB a month from North America

interface_detail: the Google Cloud console, gcloud CLI and every product API
tooling: gcloud, the client libraries, Terraform, and every tool that speaks a Google Cloud API
chaining: this is the general-purpose credit behind a Google Cloud deployment; it pairs with the separate always-free e2-micro record, which has no end date

limits.value: USD 300 of credit over 90 days from signup
a trial billing account cannot request a quota increase, cannot add GPUs, and cannot use Marketplace images that carry a licence fee

limits_note: the credit cannot pay for the Gemini API in AI Studio, for a generative AI partner model sold as a managed API, for Windows Server images, or for Marketplace fees

identity_cost.detail: a credit card or other payment method is required at signup, with a temporary authorisation hold of USD 0.00 to USD 1.00; a consumer Google account is accepted and the page does not ask for a work address; bank or phone verification applies in some countries

reliability_note: the credit expires at day 90 even after the account is upgraded to a paid billing account, and the trial cannot be paused
confidence_note: the free-features page was read on 2026-10-23 and states the amount, the 90-day window, the card requirement and the product exclusions.

evidence.proved: 'Signing up for the Free Trial creates a Free Trial billing account that is preloaded with $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days', quoted; the same page states the card requirement, the 90-day expiry after upgrade, and the Gemini API and GPU exclusions

notes: This is a different record from google-cloud-free-tier, which carries the e2-micro allowance that has no end date. The trial is the largest single balance Google publishes to an individual, and the exclusions decide what it is worth: no GPU on a trial billing account, and no Gemini API spend. A workload that plans to train on a GPU cannot use this credit for it.

extras.excluded_products: Gemini API in AI Studio, partner managed models, GPUs on a trial account, Windows Server, Marketplace
extras.rate_basis: e2-standard-4 read from the Google Cloud VM instance pricing page on 2026-10-23; e2-standard-2 is half of it and is derived, not read

binding_note: the 90-day clock ends the balance before any usage ceiling is reached
